violation_type.title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))
violation_type.short_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach
violation_type.typical_finding: Diaper changing supplies were within children's reach in two classrooms.

finding_variants.text: Diaper changing supplies were within children's reach in two classrooms.
In the infant and toddler rooms. diaper rash creams were observed to be on top of the diaper changing table in reach of children.

In the toddler room, diapers were observed in an uncovered container on the floor. In the Pre-K classroom wipies and diapers were observed stacked on a chair. In both classrooms the items were in reach of the children.
In two classrooms on the changing table or in a cubby in the bathroom there was diaper cream, disinfectant spray, and foot cream accessible to children.
A restroom used by children in care had diaper changing supplies (Caldesene Baby poweder, Honest soothing bottom wash, 2 Boogie Bottom Diaper Rash Spray) that were within reach of children.
Diaper changing supplies were observed in reach of students in the restroom.     Note: This was corrected during inspection.
